| `icon` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | URL of a logo/icon image rendered centered over the code. Ignored when the `#logo` slot is provided. Prefer `errorLevel="H"` when using a logo. |

| `margin` | `number \| undefined` | no | `4` | Quiet-zone size in modules around the code (per the QR spec the minimum is 4). |
| `size` | `number \| undefined` | no | `160` | Rendered size in pixels (width and height). |
| `status` | `DzQRStatus \| undefined` | no | `"active"` | Lifecycle status — drives the loading/expired overlays. |
| `value` | `string` | yes | — | Value to encode (URL, token, contact string, …). Required. |

Separately, the `icon` prop is a host-supplied URL rendered as an `<img src>` logo over the code, which is a subresource load and owes the url rows on its own.
